description.en: Returns the name/ID of the currently playing BGM track (as opposed to CMND_SND_GET_BGM_SNDID, which returns its runtime sound handle), so it can be restored later with CMND_SND_OPEN_BGM.
Name/ID of the currently playing BGM track.

example.code:
// Remember the current BGM track name to restore it later
history_bgm_name = CMND_SND_GET_ID_BGM();
